notes.title: The Exclusion Zone opens the doors!
notes.notes:
The "Games will be!" festival is taking place on Steam, and our project is taking part in it.
From October 1 to October 7, the game will be freely available to everyone: you can download and run a demo version of the game. During the festival, a game event will be launched, participating in which you will be able to receive various prizes, among which there will be a key for early access!
The rules of the event will be published a week before it starts.
